profile.title: Profile
profile.guestBody: Create an account to save your trips and preferences.
profile.preferencesHint: Opens travel preferences to edit them

common.reduceMotionSubtitle: Simpler screen transitions. Your device’s accessibility setting is also respected.
common.aiDataBody: Your planning request text and Guide questions are sent to an external AI service (Google Gemini). Your account, contact details and precise location are not. The AI only ranks source-checked places and writes explanations; Gonarra itself works out the schedule, times and distances.
common.legalBody: Draft — not in effect. The official Terms of Service and Privacy Policy have not been published yet. This development version is for testing only.
common.aboutBody: Explore, plan and experience Đà Nẵng, including the Hội An area. Gonarra brings local stories and travel inspiration together. You’re using a development version.
common.deleteAccountSubtitle: Delete your trips, preferences and questions
common.confirmSignOut: Sign out on this device? Your saved account details will be kept.
common.confirmResetGuest: Return to Welcome? Guest preferences on this device will be cleared.
common.sessionFailed: Could not end the session. Please try again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Small adjustments for a better journey.
settings.dataSubtitle: How your account details are stored
settings.dataBody: Clerk manages account identity and authentication. Signed-in profile details and travel preferences are saved to your account. Guest preferences stay in memory until the app restarts. Your language choice is stored on this device.
settings.sessionSubtitle: End this session on this device

language.title: App language
language.intro: Applies to the whole app and place content. Vietnamese names are always shown.
language.note: Your choice is saved on this device and applies right away.
language.saveFailed: Could not save your language choice.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.heading: Delete your account?
deleteAccount.warning: Deletion completes within 24 hours and you will be signed out. This cannot be undone.
deleteAccount.confirmHelper: Type the confirmation word to continue.
deleteAccount.failed: Could not start the deletion. Nothing was deleted. Try again.
deleteAccount.failedOffline: No connection, so nothing was deleted. Try again when you're back online.
deleteAccount.demoBody: This demo uses one shared account, so it can't be deleted. Your real account can be deleted from Settings.
deleteAccount.runningBody: Your request is confirmed. Your trips, preferences and Guide questions are deleted within 24 hours. You can sign out now.
deleteAccount.retryingBody: Deletion hit a problem and will be retried automatically. Nothing more is needed from you.
deleteAccount.doneBody: Your data has been deleted. Signing you out…
